name: gizmosql
description: Query your GizmoSQL (Arrow Flight SQL / DuckDB) server from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a GizmoSQL server over Arrow Flight SQL using the official @gizmodata/gizmosql-client and the native GizmoSQL ADBC driver (bundled for macOS, Windows x64 and Linux).

Tools: list catalogs, schemas and tables; describe a table (columns, types, constraints, estimated rows); run parameterised SQL queries with row caps and timeouts; explain a query; server info. Writes are disabled unless you enable them. A `gizmosql://schema/{catalog}/{schema}/{table}` resource returns table DDL.

The server runs on your machine and connects directly to the GizmoSQL host you configure (VPN / private networks work). Credentials are stored in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and never appear in tool output or errors.

tools.name: list_catalogs
tools.description: List the catalogs (attached databases) visible to the connected user.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas, optionally filtered to one catalog.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables and views (with type), optionally filtered by catalog, schema and a LIKE pattern.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Columns, types, nullability, constraints and estimated row count for a table or view.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a SQL query (DuckDB dialect) with optional bound parameters; returns a row-capped Markdown table plus JSON.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Return DuckDB's EXPLAIN plan for a query without executing it.

tools.name: execute_statement
tools.description: Execute a DML/DDL statement and return the affected-row count (only available when writes are enabled).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: GizmoSQL/DuckDB versions, redacted connection details, effective limits and the extension version.

tools.name: login_sso
tools.description: Sign in via the server's OAuth/SSO provider in your browser (only available when SSO is enabled).

host.title: GizmoSQL host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the GizmoSQL server (reachable from this machine, e.g. over your VPN).

port.title: Port
port.description: Flight SQL port of the GizmoSQL server.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for basic authentication (leave blank when using a token or SSO). A read-only role is recommended.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: JWT/bearer token for token authentication (alternative to username/password).

plaintext.title: Plaintext (no TLS)
plaintext.description: Connect without TLS. Only for development servers started without TLS.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Enable INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL via the execute_statement tool. Keep off unless you need it; the database user's privileges remain the real security boundary.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows per query
max_rows.description: Upper bound on rows returned by run_query.

query_timeout_seconds.title: Query timeout (seconds)
query_timeout_seconds.description: Queries running longer than this are cancelled (0 disables the timeout).

oauth_port.title: OAuth/SSO port
oauth_port.description: HTTP port of the server's OAuth endpoint (only used by SSO sign-in).

enable_sso.title: Enable SSO sign-in tool
enable_sso.description: Adds a login_sso tool that signs in through the server's OAuth/SSO identity provider in your browser (leave username/password/token blank).
